reasoning_pattern_hint: Test cases against a universal claim
core_move_guess: Test each case to disprove the universal claim.
mini_steps: Substitute values from each case into the equation
Evaluate both sides of the equation for each case
Check if the equation holds true for each case
Identify cases where the equation is false
Select the option with all counterexamples
wrong_move: Assuming the claim is true and trying to prove it, rather than looking for counterexamples.
